title: Final Probability
description: Essential Criteria: The final probability value of 0.702 must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Wave Function Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define the wave functions for both the tritium and helium-3 ion.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student should verify that the wave functions are properly normalized.

title: Integration Process
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly perform the integral involved in the probability calculation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect limits in the integration.
